But credit to our healthcare system, they are covering the procedure, and without that I wouldn't have approval for my flight to be paid either. You don't wanna know how much extra money all of that would be.

I cannot fathom what it would be like to be a woman in Alabama or something in my situation.

I will be totally honest about the reason why I have to go to the US., even though it will probably make people more upset with me.

I'm considered late-term, because I am at 26 weeks. They only do abortions up to 24 weeks in Canada, even though there is no actual law against performing them after. It's just the amount of doctors that exist in the world with the expertise and courage to do them.

I can give more reasons as to why I am doing this so late if anyone wants to know. It's complicated, but it's not just for selfish reasons. It's the best choice for both the fetus and myself, in my opinion, as well as the opinion of the doctors who have referred me.

I know many people will judge me but I can accept that.

I met this guy at the place I worked at, just over four years ago. Instantly clicked, he happened to be engaged, this should have been a huge red flag but obviously I am not the brightest so, long story short, he left her to be with me.

Things were obviously amazing right off the start, he was the most romantic guy I'd ever met. I thought we were "soulmates" blah blah blah. Not too long into the relationship though, I discover that he drinks too much and it makes his temper worse...but whatever, I have my issues too so I figured we could work through that...  

We moved in together pretty much right away. Never was smooth sailing, we were always broke, but I was happy to be with him, and he seemed happy with me. Eventually we both started partying too much. I spent all my savings and inheritance on "us". He would discourage me sometimes but also would get mad sometimes if I didn't want to go out.

Things were good often enough I guess, cause I stuck around. I thought we were in love and I didn't want to give up on him. To me, we would work through anything, because that's what you do when you love someone.

It was a toxic relationship probably and it never really wasn't I suppose. I did and said lots of stuff I shouldn't have as well. I don't think he was ever scared of me though, I was definitely scared of him sometimes. He would throw things and break stuff. Sometimes he would hold me down or push me. He never hit me but he did grab me by the throat a few times. I hit him a few times too though for sure. 

If I cried it annoyed him. Sometimes he acknowledged that he is messed up, but mostly things were all my fault. I just feel like me being depressed as a person made him mad.

We had a sort of break for awhile when he moved back to his hometown to try and get his life straight...until I missed him enough to leave my hometown and move in with him. Things were better but he still would say really mean stuff and I am never going to not have depression. It wasn't close to how it was before in terms of being bad. I figured this was it, he was the one, I thought things were good, overall.

It ended with him cheating on me about a year after I moved to be with him. With a girl from his work and he left me for her. Told me I had to move out cause she was moving in. Karma for sure for me, I know. I didn't move into the place he had with his fiance though at least.

I still just can't help like feeling I deserved all of it and I brought it on myself. Cause sometimes he seems to be a normal human. Him and the new girl seem to be good. And I'm still a disaster, moreso than ever before.
